create_SpeechDLMDataset: create a SpeechDLMDataset from MonolingualDataset instances with next, edge, and duration targets
get_item_from_SpeechDLMDataset: get a sample item by index from the SpeechDLMDataset with source and target tokens
collate_SpeechDLMDataset_samples: collate a list of SpeechDLMDataset samples into a mini-batch with padded src_tokens and targets
compute_edge_and_duration_targets: compute edge units and their durations from future target tokens using unique consecutive values
order_SpeechDLMDataset_indices: get ordered indices for batching the SpeechDLMDataset with optional shuffling and size-based sorting
